data.description:
## Problem
tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py::test_the_trace_check_detects_maintenance_inside_a_commit failed once in a 57-minute full make verify (see bug ab03-0276-374b-46af). The Trace2 file lived under the run's tmp_path and was deleted at teardown, so which of the candidate mechanisms occurred (git declined auto-maintenance, e.g. a gc.log from a previous failed auto-gc; maintenance started but was not a descendant of the commit; the event file was read before it was fully written) could not be determined. The assertion message prints an empty offender list, which looks the same in every case.

## Approach
In tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py only:
1. On failure, copy the Trace2 file and the tracker's gc.log (when present) out of tmp_path into a per-session scratch directory before teardown, and name that directory in the assertion message.
2. Make the detector's failure message distinguish the cases: no maintenance-family process in the trace at all, versus maintenance processes present but none a descendant of a commit, versus gc.log present before the commit.
Do not weaken or delete the detector, do not add retries, and do not touch production code, _AUTOMAINT_OFF, or _GIT_TIMEOUT.

## Scope
In scope: tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py and, only if needed, a small test helper. Out of scope: reproducing the failure (bug ab03-0276-374b-46af stays open for the next natural failure).

## Testing
pytest tests/unit/test_store_commit_maintenance_bd66.py -q passes; a test that forces the failure path shows the artifacts are kept and the message names the mechanism.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] When the detector assertion fails, the Trace2 file and gc.log (if any) remain on disk at a path printed in the failure message.
- [ ] The failure message distinguishes no maintenance process, maintenance not under a commit, and pre-existing gc.log.
- [ ] No wall-clock bound or retry is added and the detector's assertion is not weakened.
- [ ] make verify exits 0.
data.title: Preserve the Trace2 file and gc.log when the bd66 maintenance detector test fails, and make its failure message name the mechanism
